summary: Q1 2026 earnings reported May 19, 2026: net revenues RMB680.6M (US$98.7M), +29.6% YoY. GAAP net income RMB18.3M (vs net loss RMB17.5M in Q1 2025). Non-GAAP net income RMB47.7M. Shipped 471,723 lidar units (+140.9% YoY): 353,441 ADAS (+141.9%) and 118,282 robotics (+137.8%). Mercedes-Benz Level 3 supplier confirmed (Europe + China). Q2 guidance RMB850-900M (+20-27% YoY) above consensus. Pre-market shares +9% on May 19. Subsequent reports indicate shares declined ~15.8% post-event despite headline beat; mixed price action.
